subject: Nanotechnology
title: Gold Nanoparticles in Diagnostics
description: A 60-second lesson on Gold Nanoparticles in Diagnostics.

hook.text: The red line on a pregnancy test is made of gold nanoparticles — nano diagnostics are already everywhere.

buildup.text: Gold nanoparticles conjugated to antibodies bind the target molecule — aggregation produces visible color change.

discovery.text: Lateral flow assays use capillary action to carry the sample past gold-antibody zones — results in minutes.

twist.text: The same platform detected COVID — billions of rapid antigen tests used gold nanoparticles during the pandemic.

climax.text: Multiplexed strips can now detect several diseases at once — each line a different gold-antibody pair.

punchline.text: A stripe of gold nanoparticles gives an answer in minutes.

quiz.question: What makes the colored line appear on a lateral flow test?
options: A chemical dye reacts with the sample
Gold nanoparticles conjugated to antibodies aggregate at the test line
Fluorescent quantum dots emit light when excited
